answer: Because the garden solution is checked at the zephyr gate and logged, the anchor audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 17 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 24 pays that 106 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
